Interface QNSolverInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
CoMoMBTFSolver, CoMoMSimpleSolver, CoMoMSolver, ConvolutionSolver, MoMSolver, MonteCarloLogisticSolver, MonteCarloSolver, QNSolver, RECALNonRecursiveSolver, RECALSolver, RecursiveSolver, RGFSolver, TreeConvolutionSolver, TreeMVASolver
public interface QNSolverInterface
Interface which every solver must implement, as it defines a common way of performing the same operations, such as initialisation, evaluation and returning the results.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010
